related.title: Hayabusa 小行星採樣
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只把速率當量級比較，任何軌跡結論必須列入非重力擾動與形狀誤差。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use the speed only as a scale; any trajectory conclusion must account for nongravitational forces and shape error. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 由光學位置不確定度與接近速度估計一次接近的觀測更新需求。
related.differenceEn: Estimate observation-update requirements from optical position uncertainty and approach speed.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學引力參數 μ=650 m³/s²，距質心 r=3000 m。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：ve=sqrt(2×650/3000)。 結果約 0.658281 m/s。球對稱近似逃逸速率 ve=sqrt(2μ/r)；忽略自轉、噴流、太陽潮汐與形狀。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成初始位置 1σ=2 m，速度誤差 0.01 m/s，預測 120 s。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：σ=sqrt(2²+(120×0.01)²)。 結果約 2.33238 m。不相關誤差下位置預測 σ=sqrt(σx²+(tσv)²)；假設短時等速且無交叉協方差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching gravitational parameter μ=650 m³/s² and center distance r=3000 m. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: ve=sqrt(2×650/3000). Result ≈ 0.658281 m/s. Spherical escape speed ve=sqrt(2μ/r) neglects rotation, jets, solar tides and shape.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic initial position 1σ is 2 m, velocity error 0.01 m/s and prediction horizon 120 s. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: σ=sqrt(2²+(120×0.01)²). Result ≈ 2.33238 m. For uncorrelated errors σ=sqrt(σx²+(tσv)²), assuming short-duration constant velocity and no cross covariance.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Chandrayaan-1 月球探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只把速率當量級比較，任何軌跡結論必須列入非重力擾動與形狀誤差。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use the speed only as a scale; any trajectory conclusion must account for nongravitational forces and shape error. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 從反射光譜計算吸收帶深度，區分光譜指標與唯一礦物判定。
related.differenceEn: Calculate spectral band depth and distinguish an index from unique mineral identification.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學引力參數 μ=650 m³/s²，距質心 r=3000 m。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：ve=sqrt(2×650/3000)。 結果約 0.658281 m/s。球對稱近似逃逸速率 ve=sqrt(2μ/r)；忽略自轉、噴流、太陽潮汐與形狀。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成帶中心反射率 0.16，兩側內插連續譜 0.20。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：D=1−0.16/0.20。 結果約 0.2 fraction。帶深 D=1−R帶/R連續譜；須先校正熱輻射與觀測幾何，連續譜不能為零。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching gravitational parameter μ=650 m³/s² and center distance r=3000 m. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: ve=sqrt(2×650/3000). Result ≈ 0.658281 m/s. Spherical escape speed ve=sqrt(2μ/r) neglects rotation, jets, solar tides and shape.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic band-center reflectance is 0.16 and interpolated continuum 0.20. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: D=1−0.16/0.20. Result ≈ 0.2 fraction. Band depth D=1−Rband/Rcontinuum requires thermal and geometric correction and a nonzero continuum.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
